buySuccess.title: Payment successful
buySuccess.metaDescription: Your payment went through. Your TeachFlow download link is on its way to your inbox.
buySuccess.lead: Thank you — your payment went through.
buySuccess.body: Your download link is on its way to the email address you entered at checkout. It usually arrives within a minute or two. The link takes you to your download page, where you can fetch each skill on its own or all six as a single zip.
buySuccess.noMail: Nothing in your inbox after a few minutes? Check the spam folder first. If it is not there either, email us from the address you paid with and we will resend the link.
buySuccess.next: While the email is on its way, you can look at the install guide — the whole setup takes a couple of minutes.

home.heroTitle: One textbook unit in. A week of lessons out.
home.heroBody: Six SKILL.md skills that take the pages of one textbook unit and produce the lesson plan, the slides, the listening script and audio, the vocabulary table, three levels of worksheets, and the parent notice — in the language each of them belongs in.
home.metaDescription: Six agent skills that turn one textbook unit into the lesson plan, slides, listening audio, vocabulary table, worksheets and parent notice.

home.privacyTitle: Your students' data stays on your computer
home.privacyBody: The skills make no network requests — run them offline and they work the same. Your agent and its model are a separate product with its own data policy.

samples.title: What each skill produces
samples.lead: One textbook unit in, five files out: slides (.pptx), listening audio (.mp3), a vocabulary table (.xlsx), worksheets (.docx) and a parent notice (.png).
samples.note: Every preview below was rendered by the skills themselves from one textbook unit. The listening audio is downloadable as the .mp3 the skill produces; the other four are shown as images while their downloadable copies are prepared, and no sample contains a student or school name.
